movie.title: Bodycam
movie.overview: A call to a quiet suburban home unleashes unthinkable carnage when two officers mistakenly shoot a man and his infant child, spiraling the tragedy into a fierce, unrelenting fall into the unknown.

reviews.author: Gordon
reviews.content:
It started off kinda strong. The opening premise was good and had promise, but, as you go, they expect the viewer to have knowledge of the "Underman" and give no set-up or backstory to it.
The acting is strong. Other than that, I wouldn't recommend this movie to anyone.

reviews.author: Chin02
reviews.content: Pretty enjoyable ride for the most part. Started really strong with a mystery of what was going on that, to me at least, dropped the ball at the end. I'm always one for not showing the monster cause it's scarier that way. I'd say it is worth the watch if you like found footage movies.

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content: Found footage films are always a bit tricky. You have to establish why the cameras stay on. And a body cam born by a police officer is as good of a reason as any. The characters in this movie aren't bad at all and you feel engaged with their plight. The directing is good and the scenery is spooky. Overall it isn't bad at all. The Nebulous antagonist makes the tension a bit more interesting, and the ending is a trope, but nevertheless a good one. I recommend this if you like found footage.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When two police officers mistakenly shoot a man and his infant child during a suburban house call, their tragic mistake triggers a terrifying and unrelenting spiral into horror.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Responding to a seemingly routine call in a quiet suburban neighborhood, two police officers make a devastating error that results in the fatal shooting of an innocent man and his infant child. Desperate to mitigate the consequences, the officers find themselves caught in a rapidly escalating nightmare. As the tragedy unfolds, mysterious and horrifying forces begin to manifest, shattering their reality. The incident quickly degrades into an unrelenting, atmospheric descent into fear and psychological torment.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: What begins as a standard police dispatch to a tranquil suburban residence drastically goes wrong when two officers arrive on the scene. Misinterpreting the situation in a high-stress environment, the pair mistakenly open fire, fatally striking a father and his infant child. In the immediate aftermath, panic sets in as the officers grapple with the catastrophic reality of their actions and the immense fallout that awaits them. However, the tragedy takes a far darker turn as strange, unexplainable phenomena begin to occur around the house. The atmosphere grows heavy with terror as violent, supernatural consequences seem to take hold, refusing to let the officers escape their crime. Attempting to navigate the escalating nightmare, the officers are forced to confront both the horrific reality of their lethal mistake and an incomprehensible force seeking retribution. Their descent into chaos deepens with every passing minute, tearing away at their sanity and safety. Ultimately, the fatal call spirals into an intense, unrelenting struggle for survival against an unknown entity born from the carnage.
